description: Unify ideation storage behind the fluid-store provider seam (owner ruling 2026-07-21, PROVIDER-SEAM in what-to-build 8k): ideabox records become provider records on a zero-install local floor implemented over vision idea-type items; SmartMemory is the capability-rich reference provider backing the same records later. ideabox.md becomes a read-only generated view (ROADMAP.md<-feature.json pattern). Ideabox stays the funnel/UI/CLI. Pilot workload of the provider seam positions/joints/decisions adopt next. Honors COMP-ROADMAP Decision 4 (funnel interface pinned, not storage). One-time markdown->store migration; no bidirectional sync. Rung 1 (keystone) of COMP-PLAN-RIGOR. Anchor: docs/design/2026-07-20-front-funnel-rigor-design.md; ruling: docs/product/2026-07-20-what-to-build-vision.md 8k.
